latestVersion.changelog:
generator-for-free 1.0.0

- Initial release: generate and export 1080p MP4 videos for free from your images or video clips.
- Supports MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG files up to 500MB—no software installs required.
- Fast processing (30–60 seconds/video) on cloud GPUs with 100 free credits via anonymous login.
- Simple workflow: upload files → describe your video → receive ready-to-download result.
- Handles aspect ratio, text overlays, audio/background music, and batch/bulk operations.
- Clear error/status messages and robust handling of session, credits, and export flows.
